payload.title: A partial pour (finalize unticked, the modal default) writes NULL into the NOT NULL feeding_records.plannedAmount and should roll back, so the primary 'Add pour' flow cannot work
payload.rule_violated: A column that is NOT NULL is given a value on every path that inserts it, and a test boots the production column definition
payload.notes: Found by the 2026-10-26 Feeding production E2E audit (report: docs/reviews/claude/2026-10-27-feeding-audit-report.md).
narrative: Static plus the column definition read on production (plannedAmount numeric(10,3) NOT NULL, no default). Every real pour in production was finalize=true. The postgres fixture declares NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, which differs from production, which is why no test saw it. Fix: pass the meal's per-pour planned share (or make the column nullable), and add a postgres spec on the production definition.
